versions.subject: Merge PR #5594 from @vl43den - Update Suspicious Get Local Groups Information
versions.detection:
selection_localgroup:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'get-localgroup '
        - 'get-localgroupmember '
selection_wmi_module:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'get-wmiobject '
        - 'gwmi '
        - 'get-ciminstance '
        - 'gcim '
selection_wmi_class:
    ScriptBlockText|contains: 'win32_group' # Covers both win32_group and win32_groupuser
condition: selection_localgroup or all of selection_wmi_*
